q1.question: How to install ADHDGoFly plugin?
q1.answer:
Chrome Browser: Visit Chrome Web Store, search for "ADHDGoFly", click "Add to Chrome"

Edge Browser: Visit Microsoft Edge Add-ons Store, search for "ADHDGoFly", click "Get"

Manual Installation: Download the plugin zip file, enable "Developer mode" in browser extension management page, select "Load unpacked extension"

q2.question: How to manually install the plugin?
q2.answer:
1. Visit https://download.adhdgofly.online to download the zip installation package for your browser
  2. Extract the files:
    • Mac: Double-click the zip file to auto-extract
    • Windows: Right-click the zip file and select "Extract"
  3. Open browser extension management page:
    • Chrome: Visit chrome://extensions/
    • Edge: Visit edge://extensions/
  4. Enable "Developer mode" (Chrome) or "Developer mode" (Edge)
  5. Click "Load unpacked" or "Load unpacked extension"
  6. Select the entire extracted folder (don't select individual files within the folder)

q3.question: Can't see the plugin icon after installation?
q3.answer:
1. Check the extensions icon in the top-right corner of your browser (puzzle piece style 🧩)
  2. Find ADHDGoFly in the extensions list and click the "Pin" icon (📌)
  3. Ensure the plugin is enabled (switch is in the on position)

q4.question: Which browsers does the plugin support?
q4.answer:
• ✅ Chrome 88+
  • ✅ Microsoft Edge 88+
  • ✅ Firefox (planned support)
  • ✅ Safari (planned support)
  • ❌ IE browser (not supported)

q5.question: Why are versions inconsistent?
q5.answer:
• Manual installation: Requires manual download of updated versions
  • App store installation: Auto-updates, but may have 1-7 day delays due to official review

q6.question: How to use the highlighting feature?
q6.answer:
1. After installing the plugin, visit any webpage
  2. The plugin will automatically detect page language and load enabled dictionaries
  3. Based on set vocabulary categories and color schemes, highlight page vocabulary
  4. Click the plugin icon to adjust settings
  5. Click the close button to restore all highlighted vocabulary to original appearance

q7.question: Which languages support vocabulary highlighting?
q7.answer:
• 🇨🇳 Chinese (idioms, poetry, technical terms, etc.) - enabled by default
  • 🇺🇸 English - enabled by default
  • 🇪🇸 Spanish - requires manual activation
  • 🇫🇷 French - requires manual activation
  • 🇷🇺 Russian - requires manual activation
  • 🇯🇵 Japanese - requires manual activation
  • More languages being added continuously...

q8.question: How to modify highlighting colors?
q8.answer:
1. Click the plugin icon to open the settings panel
  2. Select the "Color Settings" tab
  3. Choose from preset color schemes (custom colors will be supported in the future)
  4. Save settings and apply to current page

q9.question: Can I add my own vocabulary?
q9.answer:
1. In the dictionary tab, expand "Custom Dictionary" and click the add button
  2. Import custom dictionary JSON file
  3. Can modify dictionary name, language, and domain type (defaults to JSON file settings)

q10.question: How to create custom dictionaries?
q10.answer:
1. Visit the custom dictionary tool: https://dictionary.adhdgofly.online/
  2. Create and export JSON file, then import to the plugin
  3. After adding, it's enabled by default and can be managed in the corresponding language dictionary list

q11.question: Does the plugin affect webpage loading speed?
q11.answer:
• The plugin uses asynchronous loading and intelligent caching technology
  • Minimal impact on page loading speed (typically <50ms)

q12.question: Why don't some page contents get highlighted?
q12.answer:
Reason: Different website structures and content display logic

Solutions:

  • If it's a commonly used website, please contact us for feedback
  • We will analyze page structure and adjust highlighting logic

Special cases: Login, payment pages involving password verification

  • If verification fails, please disable plugin highlighting first
  • The plugin doesn't steal passwords, but highlighting code may affect some websites' verification mechanisms

q13.question: Why does it show "Connection failed, please retry"?
q13.answer:
Common causes:

  1. Plugin update: Current page was opened before the update
    • Solution: Refresh the page and click the plugin icon again
  2. Special pages: Extension management pages cannot be highlighted
    • Solution: Test on other regular websites
  3. File corruption: Manually installed plugin files were accidentally deleted
    • Solution: Completely uninstall and reinstall the plugin

q14.question: Plugin doesn't work properly on certain websites?
q14.answer:
• If highlighting works on other websites but not on a specific one, that website may prohibit plugin usage
  • Please submit the problematic website to us, and we'll analyze the specific cause

q15.question: Highlighting is inaccurate or incorrect?
q15.answer:
1. This is quite common, as there are often new vocabulary words, and our dictionary doesn't 100% include all vocabulary
  2. We recommend checking question 9 and considering using custom dictionaries

q16.question: Plugin uses too much memory?
q16.answer:
1. Enable "Power saving mode" in settings
  2. Reduce the number of simultaneously loaded dictionaries
  3. Clean up useless vocabulary in custom dictionaries
  4. Regularly clear plugin cache

q17.question: Does the plugin collect my personal information?
q17.answer:
• ❌ Does not collect: Personal identification information, browsing history, page content
  • ✅ Only collects with your permission: Anonymous usage statistics (such as language preferences, feature usage frequency)
  • 🔒 Promise: All data is completely anonymous and cannot be traced to individuals
  • 📋 Details: View complete privacy policy (https://privacy.adhdgofly.online) for more information

q18.question: How to disable data collection?
q18.answer:
1. Find "Privacy Settings" in plugin settings
  2. Turn off "Anonymous Usage Statistics" switch
  3. After turning off, no usage data will be collected
  4. Does not affect normal plugin functionality

q19.question: Is the plugin safe?
q19.answer:
• ✅ Open source code, viewable on GitHub
  • ✅ Passed browser store security review
  • ✅ Does not access sensitive permissions
  • ✅ Regular security updates, no malicious code

q20.question: Can it be used on mobile phones?
q20.answer:
• Currently Edge mobile can install some official extensions
  • ADHDGoFly plugin is not yet on the official support list
  • We are applying to join the official support list
  • If you use Edge, please rate us in the add-ons store to help us get support earlier

q21.question: What to do about conflicts with other plugins?
q21.answer:
1. Identify conflicting plugins (usually other page modification plugins)
  2. Adjust plugin priority in settings
  3. Use "Compatibility mode" to reduce conflicts
  4. Temporarily disable other plugins for testing if necessary

q22.question: Settings lost after plugin update?
q22.answer:
• Normally updates don't affect settings
  • Future versions will support settings file export functionality

q23.question: Does it support keyboard shortcuts to enable/disable highlighting?
q23.answer:
• Currently does not support keyboard shortcuts
  • Future versions will consider adding keyboard shortcut settings

  3. Email contact: support@adhdgofly.com

q25.question: How to submit feature suggestions?

1. Submit suggestions via WeChat zuoguyoupan2023 or feedback website (https://feedback.adhdgofly.online)

descriptions.zh: Based on Jieba Chinese word segmentation dictionary, containing part-of-speech annotations for common vocabulary. Data sourced from public Chinese linguistic resources.
descriptions.en: Based on WordNet English dictionary, providing accurate part-of-speech classification and semantic relationships. WordNet is a large English lexical database developed by Princeton University.
descriptions.fr: Sourced from Morphalou French morphological dictionary, containing basic vocabulary part-of-speech information and morphological analysis.
descriptions.ru: Based on OpenCorpora open-source Russian corpus project, providing basic part-of-speech annotation functionality. Completely open and supports commercial use.
descriptions.es: Sourced from Apertium open-source machine translation platform's Spanish linguistic resources, supporting common vocabulary recognition.
descriptions.ja: Based on JMdict open-source Japanese multilingual dictionary, containing part-of-speech information for kana and kanji. Completely open and supports commercial use.
